Wellness / The Bahamas

Tranquilitas Day Spa

Mobile massage at hotels, villas, yachts and beaches, alongside a Nassau day spa offering couples treatments, facials and wellness services.

Tranquilitas provides in-spa appointments at #7 Fourth Terrace, Collins Avenue, Nassau, plus mobile massage experiences across Nassau and Paradise Island. Its online booking pages describe therapist-led treatments at hotels, villas, private homes, yachts and beaches, with additional Caribbean destination requests coordinated subject to therapist availability and local confirmation. Guests can request Swedish, deep tissue, couples and other spa treatments. Island-specific coverage and appointment availability must be confirmed directly with the company; regional reach is a company-reported service offering, not an independently audited ranking.
